last.verdict: Teva's three newer brand drugs grew 33% to about $1.1 billion, offsetting falling generics and prompting another full-year sales guidance increase.

takeaways.label: Brand drugs outrunning guidance
takeaways.text: Austedo sales rose 21% to $751M, Ajovy 61% and Uzedy 96%. Austedo's 2026 outlook rose to $2.55–2.65B from $2.45–2.6B.

takeaways.label: Generics drag, margins improve
takeaways.text: Total revenue fell 2% to $4.4B as generics dropped 16% on lower generic Revlimid sales. Adjusted gross margin still rose to 58.7% from 55.3%.

takeaways.label: Full-year outlook nudged up
takeaways.text: 2026 revenue guidance is now $16.7–17.0B, up from $16.5–16.85B. Adjusted EPS is $0.86 for the quarter, up 10%.

takeaways.label: Debt load easing
takeaways.text: Teva refinanced about $4.9B of debt this quarter and earned investment-grade ratings from Moody's and S&P. Total debt is still $16.7B.

history.verdict: Stronger brand-drug sales and raised guidance outweighed a profit miss.

reasons.label: Austedo outlook raised
reasons.text: 2026 Austedo sales guidance lifted to $2.45–2.6 billion; U.S. sales up 33%.

reasons.label: Revenue guidance raised
reasons.text: 2026 revenue outlook raised to $16.5–16.85 billion on Austedo, Ajovy and Uzedy.

reasons.label: Miss blamed on deal
reasons.text: Adjusted EPS of 2 cents missed; Emalex acquisition cost about 61 cents per share.
